pr_title: [BugFix]Fix the precision issue of the npu_dequant_swiglu_quant operator when x.shape=[2,192]
source_quote: ![high] The correctness assertions for the 64-aligned cases are **commented out**. This prevents the test from actually verifying the correctness of the operator. **Please uncomment these assertions** so that the test can catch potential regressions.

pattern.code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("x_shape, clamp_limit, desc", [
    ([8, 384], 0.0, "small_384_aligned"),
    ([2, 192], 0.0, "small_192_misaligned"),          # xfail 标记已移除
    ([4, 192], 0.0, "small_192_misaligned_4rows"),     # xfail 标记已移除
])
def test_npu_dequant_swiglu_quant_with_limit(x_shape, clamp_limit, desc):
    # ... 前置：构造输入、编译 graph、执行 fused 算子 ...
    output, output_scale = run_dequant_swiglu_quant(x_shape, clamp_limit)
    output_golden, output_scale_golden = run_golden_reference(x_shape, clamp_limit)

    graph.replay()

    # int8 quantization output: atol=1 covers the rounding error
    torch.testing.assert_close(output.cpu(), output_golden.cpu(), atol=1, rtol=0.1)
    # Dynamic quant scale: atol/rtol to cover non-64-aligned outDimy
    torch.testing.assert_close(output_scale.cpu(), output_scale_golden.cpu(), atol=1e-4, rtol=5e-3)
    # ↑ 两行 uncomment，参数与 gemini suggestion snippet 给出的字面完全一致
